newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CSFB downgrades TVK to "hold" on results.
newsitem.headline: CSFB downgrades TVK to "hold" on results.

text.p: CS First Boston downgraded Hungarian chemicals maker Tiszai Vegyi Kombinat Rt's (TVK) shares to "hold" after the company reported "disappointing results for full-year 1996" on Friday.
"Higher feedstock prices during the fourth quarter (and the first quarter of 1997) did (and will) depress olefin margins," CSFB's Budapest-based analyst Spencer Jakab said.
TVK's net profit dropped to 7.81 billion forints in 1996 from 10.47 billion in 1995, the company said on Friday.
The average price of TVK's main feedstock, chemicals benzene rose 21 percent to $193 per tonne in 1996. @
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, TVK shares closed at 2,200 forints, down 420.
